title: DataLife Write Block Trace
description: Block-range trace for write operations, produced by DataLife flow-monitor. Filename pattern: <file>.<pid>-<host>.w_blk_trace.json

io_blk_range.description: This process's access pattern for the file, in 4096-byte blocks with inclusive ends: [first block accessed, last block accessed, largest block accessed, -1 while every access started at or after the end of the previous one, -2 once one did not]. Builds with BLK_IDX instead list one [start, end] pair per access.

task_name.description: Optional task name for workflow correlation.
